## History

Carrie Sloane is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who attends [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) School. During a game of dares at Diana's party, Carrie dares [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) to climb a big oak tree, which Ruby successfully accomplishes before [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) subsequently dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of the roof.
